name_reason: Follows data_fd2_battle_* convention for a battle-domain core animation state byte; descriptor (summon_spell sprite anim tick counter) accurately reflects purpose and the counter data-type role. No Ghidra address residue (the trailing 'counter' is a role word, not a hex address). Confirmed byte-wide hold counter via disasm.
purpose: Sprite-animation hold/tick counter for the generic single-target summon-spell animation, paired with the phase byte @ 0x53F7E.
logic_summary: Single unsigned byte. INIT (state_code 0) of fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state clears it (MOV byte ptr [0x53F80],0 @ 0x26583) before any read this run. It is passed by address (PUSH 0x53f80 @ 0x26604 and 0x26671) to fd2_tick_sprite_animation_step, which increments it each tick (*p_tick)++ and resets it to 0 (advancing the phase byte) once it reaches the per-frame hold value read from the sprite sheet. All access is byte-wide and unsigned.
element_semantics: Single uint8 hold counter: ticks elapsed displaying the current animation frame; wraps to 0 and bumps the phase/frame index when it hits the per-frame hold count.
notes: Zero-bss runtime scratch (.object2, on-disk image 0x00; read_memory @ 0x53F80 returned all zeros). Only referencing function is fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state (1 WRITE @ 0x26583 + 2 by-address passes @ 0x26604/0x26671). Ghidra DT=byte, SYM byte-identical with src. src comment (anisummn.c lines 702-714) already precise/correct/ASCII; Ghidra plate already consistent (carries extra site addresses, allowed). No src edit, no plate edit.
